description: This file implements category management functions for the focalboard server, including creating, updating, deleting, reordering categories, and moving boards to default categories.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct managing categories, boards, and websocket broadcasting.

methods.name: CreateCategory
methods.description: Creates a new category after validation.

methods.name: UpdateCategory
methods.description: Updates an existing category with permission and validity checks.

methods.name: DeleteCategory
methods.description: Deletes a category after permission checks and moves boards to default category.

methods.name: moveBoardsToDefaultCategory
methods.description: Moves boards from a specified category to the user's default category.

methods.name: ReorderCategories
methods.description: Reorders categories based on a new order, with validation.

methods.name: verifyNewCategoriesMatchExisting
methods.description: Validates that the new category order matches existing categories.
